That CEO of Proton is a klunt. Don't talk to your employees like that, even if you disagree.

Andy Yen, the CEO of Proton, had a message for an employee in the company’s security Slack channel who urged the company to at least take a few days to pentest newly written code before pushing it live. “That’s bullshit and loser thinking. In a follow-up message, Yen reiterated his point: “only losers think like that.” His ultimate message for the team was to “stop lovingly handcrafting all our code and use AI more.”

content.text/plain: 2/🧵To clarify, I am not a rabid anti-AI person, as I believe that properly deployed & utilized this powerful new tech has positive contributions to make, in academia, research, mathematics, drug development - across the sciences really. But I am very concerned about the lack of ‘adult’ oversight, proper guardrails, and government regulation. I simply do not TRUST the #Billionaires and #oligarchs who fund & control #AI companies. No way they’re going to do “the right thing” imo. We’re rushing into this new #ArtificialIntelligence age without doing our due diligence, without adult supervision (imo), without meaningful regulatory oversight - all to chase profits. We need serous discussions around the questionable ‘circular funding’ behind this boom; the distinct possibility the bubble will burst; advancements toward AGI and RSI, and the implications of that; and AI impacts on our job market, society & culture. Until those conversations are well underway, we need to hit PAUSE imo.

content.text/plain: Anthropic researchers say AI could cause human extinction by 2030 - when actual #AI execs are sounding the alarm & resigning, we ought to take note. Many frontier #ArtificialIntelligence models are claiming to have reached AGI - human-level reasoning. Even more pertinent, some AI experts are reporting that advanced models are already at the “recursive self-improvement” (RSI) stage - meaning models can autonomously test their own performance, ID flaws, and write new algorithms to make even better versions of themselves. Pair that with the recent #OpenAI Hugging Face rogue agent breakout - where autonomous agents massed at a wiki & plotted more breakouts, & we’re seeing the 1st signs of a potential AI apocalypse. Consider that concurrently, we’re seeing the 1st gen of network-connected AI-driven, autonomous weaponry. It’s easy to imagine a scenario where rogue AI takes over autonomous weapons, like drones & robotic troops, to achieve its ends.  https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/sep/09/anthropic-researchers-ai-human-extinction  #Anthropic #Doomsday #AIApocalypse
